files.world.sop:
@world.acts core.world
    namespace=acts
    version=0.1.0
    legend=$legend.acts
    imports=world.core
    imports=world.lang.common
    formalization=rules
    language=en
    status=fixture
    title="Acts"
    summary=""
    doc="A shared module, not a tab (spec 21): about twelve universal acts (make, remove, change, place, connect, group, pick, ask, copy, send, undo and redo, save and load) with six roles (thing, set, attribute, value, place, amount). The act words are core.phrase groups here (acts.verb.*, acts.det) and the relation words a lexicon (lex.acts.rel); the forms, the schema reader, the generic executor with undo, difference, reply and why-answer, and the graded fallback are in acts.mjs, a browser-safe module. A doing world declares a schema.sop and gets its lexicons, patterns, operations and templates generated by scripts/build-schema-world.mjs. This world has no patterns and no operations of its own, so it is never a routing target. The seed verbs are TEMPORARY: they are deleted when the knowledge repo k.actions is read through the catalog. Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."
